correctness.rationale: Exact monomial beta moments yield the correct kernel. The Euler-transform numerator G has five known simple polynomial zeros at the critical parameters, exactly two on the unit circle. Uniform control over the closed unit disk and the analytic implicit-function theorem rule out extra zeros and establish unique local conjugate roots. Exact derivative integrals give radial derivatives \(-49/720\) and \(-\pi\sqrt3/36\), producing slope \(-49\sqrt3/(60\pi)\). The checker passed exact identities and finite numerical transverse tests; the analytic proof covers the universal quantifiers.

value.rationale: The theorem resolves the first complex-conjugate Lu Qi-Keng zero-entry boundary, not merely the kernel formula, for a natural mixed power weight with continuously varying fractional origin exponent. It classifies all kernel zeros throughout a parameter neighborhood and provides an exact nonzero sensitivity coefficient, enabling quantitative comparison of zero-free weighted Bergman geometries.
